attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: pdf_article_extraction_via_ai_vision
steps:
  - id: step_authenticate
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "automation_service_account"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_search_drive
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/google-drive/search"
      query:
        folder: "pending_articles"
        mime_type: "application/pdf"
    output: raw_pdf_list

  - id: step_validate_pdf_list
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_pdf_list
      schema: pdf_file_list_schema
    output: validated_pdf_list

  - id: step_loop_pdfs
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: validated_pdf_list
      steps:
        - download_pdf
        - send_to_vision_api
        - parse_ai_response
        - sanitize_quotes
        - validate_extracted_fields
        - ensure_lead_not_empty
        - handle_format_routing
        - write_article
        - log_extraction
    output: loop_result

  - id: download_pdf
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/google-drive/download"
      file_id_from: validated_pdf_list
    output: raw_pdf_binary

  - id: send_to_vision_api
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: raw_pdf_binary
      url: "https://ai-vision.example.com/extract"
      method: "POST"
      headers:
        Content-Type: "application/pdf"
      body_template:
        prompt: "Extract structured article content: title, author, section, lead, body, highlighted_quotes, sidebars. If the document contains multiple book reviews, set es_multiple to true and return an array of articles."
    output: raw_ai_response

  - id: parse_ai_response
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: raw_ai_response
      mapping:
        strip_markdown_fences: true
        parse_json_body: true
    output: parsed_ai_content

  - id: sanitize_quotes
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: parsed_ai_content
      mapping:
        replace_double_quotes_in_values: true
        replacement_char: "'"
    output: sanitized_content

  - id: validate_extracted_fields
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: sanitized_content
      schema:
        required_fields:
          - title
          - section
          - content
        conditional:
          when_es_multiple_true:
            type: array
            items_required:
              - title
              - section
              - content
    output: validated_content

  - id: ensure_lead_not_empty
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      input: validated_content
      rule: "lead_field_must_not_be_empty"
      fallback: "If lead is empty, derive from first 150 characters of content body"
    output: content_with_lead

  - id: handle_format_routing
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "content_with_lead.es_multiple == true"
      true_step: process_multiple_reviews
      false_step: write_article

  - id: process_multiple_reviews
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: content_with_lead
      steps:
        - write_article
        - log_extraction
    output: multi_review_result

  - id: write_article
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: content_with_lead
      table: extracted_articles
      columns:
        - title
        - author
        - section
        - lead
        - body
        - highlighted_quotes
        - sidebars
        - es_multiple
    output: write_result

  - id: log_extraction
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: content_with_lead
      event: "article_extracted_from_pdf"
      details:
        title_field: "content_with_lead.title"
        section_field: "content_with_lead.section"
        es_multiple: "content_with_lead.es_multiple"
    output: audit_result

  - id: step_handle_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      on_error: notify_admin
    output: error_handle_result

  - id: notify_admin
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: error_handle_result
      recipient: "admin@economics-magazine.com"
      channel: "email"
      message: "PDF article extraction workflow encountered an error. Please review the audit log."
    output: notify_result

  - id: step_terminate
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
